observed_model_settings: Parent controller verified prep agent turn_context gpt-6-astra effort medium; verify each actual worker

randomization.method: Seeded Random: two first positions each, random odd extra, shuffle five rounds

access_limitations: Filesystem separation does not enforce read isolation; reviewed installed dependencies and standard library are trusted. No exhaustive syscall audit.
independent_context_mechanism: Fresh generation agent per attempt, fork_turns=none, one uninterrupted session; no subordinate agents
deadline_enforcement: Controller host monitoring plus worker instruction; start at case packet dispatch, not preflight
review_procedure: One fresh independent reviewer per frozen submission, only after all generation stops; no submitted-proof repairs, validation copies only; unresolved candidate at limit REVIEW; human adjudication optional separate record

host_capabilities.measurement: Controller verified host cumulative input/cached-input/output/reasoning/total counters and task boundaries; map every session and block request; missing precise service request IDs remain explicit

adapter_synthetic_regression.operational_adjustment: All options precede mode and -- targets; unchanged adapter source. Original invocation failures preserved.

continuation.canonical_callback_adapter: unsupported binding; native same-session mechanism used
continuation.message: Proceed with the next step under the existing case instructions.
continuation.evidence: controller-events.jsonl and host/controller-access-calls.json; host tool responses and turn contexts confirm delivery
continuation.deadline_enforcement: controller checks original deadline before continuation; workers also instructed to stop at deadline

adapter_invocation_note: Use options first, then mode and explicit targets; controller identified argparse positional/optional intermixing obstruction. No adapter source modification.

measurement_definitions.dispatch: Controller timestamp immediately before initial case followup; includes bounded packet-release and native dispatch-call latency. Frozen deadline is not shifted later. Native task boundaries are retained for audit.
measurement_definitions.stop: Latest matching host task_complete where available, otherwise controller-observed stop.
measurement_definitions.handoff: Previous block continues through handoff wait until controller transition immediately before the next same-session request.
measurement_definitions.tokens: Differences in host cumulative counters after preflight baseline; total is input plus output, cached input and reasoning are subsets. Missing API request IDs are represented by stable host session/turn/event identities.
measurement_definitions.activity: No inferred allocation from block labels; absent orthogonal activity events remain unallocated.
